instruction.text: Select the subordinating conjunction in the sentence.

hint.text: Subordinating conjunctions combine an independent clause with a dependent clause.

atoms.b: I will meet Sarah ((after)) finishing my homework.
atoms.sound: I will meet Sarah after finishing my homework.

instruction.text: Find the subordinating conjunction in the sentence.

hint.text: Subordinating conjunctions combine an independent clause with a dependent clause.

atoms.b: George is wearing shorts ((because)) it is warm outside.
atoms.sound: George is wearing shorts because it is warm outside.

instruction.text: Find the subordinating conjunction in the sentence.

hint.text: Subordinating conjunctions combine an independent clause with a dependent clause.

atoms.b: You should wash your hands ((before)) you start cooking.
atoms.sound: You should wash your hands before you start cooking.

hint.text: Subordinating conjunctions combine an independent clause with a dependent clause.
